nuclear-family.en: The nuclear family has replaced larger households in most modern cities.
nuclear-family.zh: 在大多数现代城市,核心家庭已取代较大的家庭。

extended-family.en: Children in an extended family often receive care from their grandparents.
extended-family.zh: 大家庭中的孩子常常得到祖父母的照顾。

single-parent-family.en: Children from a single-parent family can do just as well at school.
single-parent-family.zh: 单亲家庭的孩子在学校同样可以表现得很好。

sibling.en: Children without siblings may have fewer chances to learn how to share.
sibling.zh: 没有兄弟姐妹的孩子学习分享的机会可能更少。

spouse.en: Working abroad can put pressure on the relationship between a person and their spouse.
spouse.zh: 在国外工作可能给一个人与配偶的关系带来压力。

relative.en: Older people are increasingly being looked after by a professional rather than a relative.
relative.zh: 老年人越来越多地由专业人员而不是亲戚照顾。

relative.en: The relative cost of food has fallen over the past fifty years.
relative.zh: 过去五十年,食品的相对成本有所下降。

generation.en: Each generation tends to criticise the behaviour of the one that follows it.
generation.zh: 每一代人都倾向于批评下一代人的行为。

generation-gap.en: Rapid technological change has made the generation gap wider than ever.
generation-gap.zh: 快速的技术变革使代沟比以往任何时候都大。

upbringing.en: A child's upbringing has a strong influence on their later behaviour.
upbringing.zh: 孩子的教养对其日后的行为有很大影响。

parenting.en: Good parenting involves setting clear limits as well as showing love.
parenting.zh: 好的育儿既要有爱,也要设定明确的界限。

raise.en: It is argued that parents should raise children to respect other cultures.
raise.zh: 有人认为,父母在抚养孩子时应教导他们尊重其他文化。

raise.en: The government could raise money for public transport by taxing private cars.
raise.zh: 政府可以通过对私家车征税来为公共交通筹集资金。

raise.en: The report raises serious questions about the safety of the food we eat.
raise.zh: 这份报告对我们所吃食物的安全提出了严肃的问题。

spoil.en: Parents who give their children too many toys may spoil them.
spoil.zh: 给孩子太多玩具的父母可能会把他们宠坏。

spoil.en: Large numbers of tourists can spoil the natural beauty of an area.
spoil.zh: 大量游客可能破坏一个地区的自然美景。

pamper.en: Parents who pamper their children may make them less independent.
pamper.zh: 娇惯孩子的父母可能让孩子变得不那么独立。

bond.en: Eating together strengthens the bond between parents and children.
bond.zh: 一起吃饭能加强父母和孩子之间的纽带。

intimacy.en: Technology may reduce the intimacy of family relationships.
intimacy.zh: 技术可能减少家庭关系的亲密。

harmony.en: Respect for elders helps to maintain harmony within the family.
harmony.zh: 尊敬长辈有助于维持家庭和谐。

sense-of-belonging.en: Team sports give young people a strong sense of belonging.
sense-of-belonging.zh: 团队运动给年轻人带来强烈的归属感。

domestic.en: Domestic tasks should be shared equally between men and women.
domestic.zh: 家务应该由男女平等分担。

domestic.en: The domestic economy has been badly affected by the fall in exports.
domestic.zh: 国内经济受到出口下降的严重影响。

domestic-violence.en: Victims of domestic violence need safe places to go and legal support.
domestic-violence.zh: 家庭暴力的受害者需要安全的去处和法律支持。

household.en: The average household now produces more waste than ever before.
household.zh: 现在普通家庭产生的垃圾比以往任何时候都多。

housework.en: Men today do much more housework than their fathers did.
housework.zh: 如今的男性比他们的父辈做更多家务。

chores.en: Children should help with household chores from an early age.
chores.zh: 孩子应该从小帮忙做家务。

breadwinner.en: In many families today, the woman is the main breadwinner.
breadwinner.zh: 如今在许多家庭中,女性是主要的养家糊口的人。

dual-income.en: Dual-income families often struggle to find enough time with their children.
dual-income.zh: 双收入家庭常常很难有足够的时间陪孩子。

childcare.en: The high cost of childcare prevents many mothers from returning to work.
childcare.zh: 高昂的托儿费用使许多母亲无法重返工作岗位。

nursery.en: Government funding for nursery places would help working parents.
nursery.zh: 政府资助托儿所名额将帮助在职父母。

divorce.en: Children of parents who divorce may need extra support at school.
divorce.zh: 父母离婚的孩子在学校可能需要额外支持。

cohabit.en: More couples now cohabit for several years before getting married.
cohabit.zh: 现在越来越多的情侣在结婚前同居几年。

birth-rate.en: A falling birth rate means there will be fewer workers in the future.
birth-rate.zh: 出生率下降意味着未来工人减少。

fertility-rate.en: The fertility rate has fallen sharply as more women go to university.
fertility-rate.zh: 随着上大学的女性增多,生育率急剧下降。

population-growth.en: Rapid population growth puts pressure on food and water supplies.
population-growth.zh: 人口快速增长给食物和水的供应带来压力。

community.en: Strong community ties can reduce loneliness among older residents.
community.zh: 紧密的社区联系能减少老年居民的孤独感。

social-cohesion.en: Shared public spaces can help to improve social cohesion in large cities.
social-cohesion.zh: 共享的公共空间有助于增强大城市的社会凝聚力。

social-mobility.en: Free higher education can increase social mobility for children from poor families.
social-mobility.zh: 免费高等教育能提高贫困家庭孩子的社会流动性。

inequality.en: Inequality between rich and poor has grown in many developed countries.
inequality.zh: 在许多发达国家,贫富之间的不平等加剧了。

wealth-gap.en: Higher taxes on the rich could help to reduce the wealth gap.
wealth-gap.zh: 提高对富人的税收有助于缩小贫富差距。

underprivileged.en: Scholarships give underprivileged children the chance to attend good universities.
underprivileged.zh: 奖学金让弱势儿童有机会上好大学。

disadvantaged.en: Disadvantaged students often need extra help from teachers.
disadvantaged.zh: 处于劣势的学生往往需要老师的额外帮助。

homeless.en: The government should do more to help homeless people find housing.
homeless.zh: 政府应该做更多的事,帮助无家可归的人找到住房。

donate.en: Wealthy people should donate more of their money to charity.
donate.zh: 富人应该把更多的钱捐给慈善机构。

donation.en: A large donation from a local business paid for the new library.
donation.zh: 当地一家企业的巨额捐款支付了新图书馆的费用。

materialism.en: Modern advertising strongly encourages materialism among young people.
materialism.zh: 现代广告大大助长了年轻人的物质主义。

consumerism.en: Consumerism encourages people to buy things they do not really need.
consumerism.zh: 消费主义鼓励人们购买并不真正需要的东西。

individualism.en: Western societies tend to place greater value on individualism.
individualism.zh: 西方社会往往更重视个人主义。

collectivism.en: In cultures based on collectivism, the needs of the group come first.
collectivism.zh: 在以集体主义为基础的文化中,群体的需求放在首位。

lifestyle.en: A healthy lifestyle can reduce the risk of many serious diseases.
lifestyle.zh: 健康的生活方式可以降低许多严重疾病的风险。

work-life-balance.en: Flexible hours can help employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
work-life-balance.zh: 弹性工作时间能帮助员工更好地实现工作与生活的平衡。

surname.en: In many countries, a woman no longer takes her husband's surname.
surname.zh: 在许多国家,女性不再随丈夫的姓。

nickname.en: Children may feel hurt if they are given an unkind nickname at school.
nickname.zh: 如果在学校被起了难听的绰号,孩子可能会感到受伤。

engaged.en: Couples often stay engaged for several years to save money for a home.
engaged.zh: 情侣常常订婚几年,为买房攒钱。

widow.en: An elderly widow may feel very lonely after the death of her husband.
widow.zh: 年迈的寡妇在丈夫去世后可能感到非常孤独。

marital.en: Financial problems are a common cause of marital difficulties.
marital.zh: 财务问题是婚姻困难的常见原因。

attachment.en: Young children form a strong attachment to the people who care for them.
attachment.zh: 幼儿对照顾他们的人产生强烈的依恋。

affinity.en: Young people often feel a natural affinity with new technology.
affinity.zh: 年轻人往往对新技术有一种天然的亲近感。

mistreat.en: Care homes that mistreat older people should be closed down immediately.
mistreat.zh: 虐待老人的护理院应该立即关闭。

equality.en: Equality between men and women should begin at home.
equality.zh: 男女平等应该从家庭开始。

needy.en: Charities provide food and clothing for needy families in the area.
needy.zh: 慈善机构为该地区的贫困家庭提供食物和衣物。

impoverished.en: Aid should be directed towards the most impoverished regions of the world.
impoverished.zh: 援助应该投向世界上最贫困的地区。

starvation.en: Millions of people still face starvation because of war and drought.
starvation.zh: 由于战争和干旱,数百万人仍然面临饥饿。

decent.en: Every worker deserves a decent wage and safe working conditions.
decent.zh: 每个工人都应该获得体面的工资和安全的工作条件。

shabby.en: Many older people live in shabby flats they can barely afford to heat.
shabby.zh: 许多老人住在破旧的公寓里,几乎付不起取暖费。

materialistic.en: Critics say that modern society has become too materialistic.
materialistic.zh: 批评者说现代社会变得过于物质主义。

mercenary.en: Some companies have a mercenary attitude towards their customers.
mercenary.zh: 一些公司对待顾客的态度唯利是图。

ostentatious.en: Ostentatious displays of wealth can increase envy among poorer people.
ostentatious.zh: 炫耀财富可能加剧较贫穷人群的嫉妒。

pretentious.en: Some people find modern art pretentious and difficult to understand.
pretentious.zh: 有些人觉得现代艺术自命不凡,难以理解。

social-welfare.en: Higher taxes are needed to pay for social welfare programmes.
social-welfare.zh: 需要提高税收来支付社会福利项目。

fast-paced.en: The fast-paced life of big cities can cause a great deal of stress.
fast-paced.zh: 大城市快节奏的生活可能造成很大压力。

stiff-competition.en: Small shops face stiff competition from large supermarkets and online stores.
stiff-competition.zh: 小商店面临大型超市和网店的激烈竞争。

disability.en: People with a disability should have equal access to public buildings.
disability.zh: 残疾人应该能平等地使用公共建筑。

elite.en: Expensive private schools help to keep power in the hands of an elite.
elite.zh: 昂贵的私立学校有助于把权力保持在精英手中。

donor.en: An anonymous donor gave a large sum of money to the hospital.
donor.zh: 一位匿名捐赠者向医院捐赠了一大笔钱。

socially.en: Children who spend too much time online may become socially isolated.
socially.zh: 上网时间过长的孩子可能在社交上变得孤立。

mobility.en: Regular exercise helps older people to maintain their mobility.
mobility.zh: 经常锻炼有助于老年人保持行动能力。

sexuality.en: Attitudes towards sexuality have changed considerably over the last fifty years.
sexuality.zh: 过去五十年,人们对性取向的态度发生了很大变化。

maternal.en: Maternal health has improved greatly in many developing countries.
maternal.zh: 在许多发展中国家,母亲的健康状况大大改善。

gender.en: Jobs should be given according to ability, regardless of gender.
gender.zh: 工作应该根据能力分配,不分性别。

elderly.en: Elderly people have a great deal of knowledge to pass on to the young.
elderly.zh: 年长的人有大量知识可以传给年轻人。

youngster.en: A youngster with a good role model is less likely to get into trouble.
youngster.zh: 有好榜样的年轻人不太可能惹上麻烦。

guardian.en: Each child's parent or guardian must sign the form before the trip.
guardian.zh: 旅行前,每个孩子的父母或监护人都必须在表格上签字。

abortion.en: Laws on abortion differ greatly from one country to another.
abortion.zh: 关于堕胎的法律在不同国家差异很大。

ageing-population.en: An ageing population will increase the demand for health care.
ageing-population.zh: 人口老龄化将增加对医疗保健的需求。

the-elderly.en: The elderly should be respected for their experience and knowledge.
the-elderly.zh: 老年人的经验和知识应该得到尊重。

senior-citizen.en: Every senior citizen should have free access to public transport.
senior-citizen.zh: 每位老年人都应该可以免费乘坐公共交通。

pensioner.en: Many pensioners struggle to pay for heating during the winter.
pensioner.zh: 许多领养老金的人在冬天难以负担取暖费。

retirement.en: Many people find it difficult to adapt to life after retirement.
retirement.zh: 许多人觉得很难适应退休后的生活。

retirement-age.en: Many governments are raising the retirement age because people live longer.
retirement-age.zh: 由于人们寿命延长,许多国家的政府正在提高退休年龄。

nursing-home.en: Some older people feel lonely after moving into a nursing home.
nursing-home.zh: 一些老人搬进养老院后感到孤独。

care-home.en: Staff in a care home should receive proper training and fair pay.
care-home.zh: 护理院的员工应该接受适当的培训并获得公平的薪水。

caregiver.en: A family caregiver often needs support as well as the person being looked after.
caregiver.zh: 家庭照料者往往和被照顾者一样需要支持。

empty-nester.en: An empty-nester may have more time to travel and take up new hobbies.
empty-nester.zh: 空巢老人可能有更多时间旅行和培养新爱好。

lonely.en: Many elderly people feel lonely because their children live far away.
lonely.zh: 许多老人感到孤独,因为他们的孩子住得很远。

vulnerable.en: Governments have a special duty to protect the most vulnerable people in society.
vulnerable.zh: 政府有特别的责任保护社会中最脆弱的人。

frail.en: Frail older people may need help with simple daily tasks.
frail.zh: 虚弱的老人可能需要帮忙完成简单的日常事务。

dependent.en: More elderly people are becoming dependent on their children for support.
dependent.zh: 越来越多的老年人依赖子女的支持。

burden.en: An ageing population may become a heavy burden on younger taxpayers.
burden.zh: 人口老龄化可能成为年轻纳税人的沉重负担。

pension-scheme.en: Companies should offer every worker a good pension scheme.
pension-scheme.zh: 公司应该为每位员工提供良好的养老金计划。

workforce-shortage.en: A workforce shortage could slow economic growth in countries with fewer young people.
workforce-shortage.zh: 在年轻人较少的国家,劳动力短缺可能减缓经济增长。

filial-piety.en: Filial piety remains an important value in many Asian societies.
filial-piety.zh: 孝道仍然是许多亚洲社会的重要价值观。

wisdom.en: Older people can pass on their wisdom to younger members of society.
wisdom.zh: 老年人可以把智慧传给社会的年轻成员。

physical-exercise.en: Regular physical exercise can reduce the risk of many serious diseases.
physical-exercise.zh: 经常进行体育锻炼可以降低许多严重疾病的风险。

balanced-diet.en: Schools should teach children the importance of a balanced diet.
balanced-diet.zh: 学校应该教导孩子均衡饮食的重要性。

junk-food.en: Advertising of junk food to children should be banned on television.
junk-food.zh: 应该禁止在电视上向儿童宣传垃圾食品。

fast-food.en: The growth of fast food has contributed to rising levels of obesity.
fast-food.zh: 快餐的发展导致肥胖率上升。

processed-food.en: A diet high in processed food can lead to serious health problems.
processed-food.zh: 大量食用加工食品可能导致严重的健康问题。

additive.en: Food labels should list every additive used in the product.
additive.zh: 食品标签应该列出产品中使用的每种添加剂。

preservative.en: Some people avoid any food containing a chemical preservative.
preservative.zh: 有些人避免吃含有化学防腐剂的任何食品。

food-safety.en: Stricter laws are needed to improve food safety in restaurants.
food-safety.zh: 需要更严格的法律来改善餐馆的食品安全。

overweight.en: Overweight children are more likely to have health problems as adults.
overweight.zh: 超重儿童成年后更容易出现健康问题。

mental-health.en: Too much time on social media may damage the mental health of teenagers.
mental-health.zh: 花太多时间在社交媒体上可能损害青少年的心理健康。

physical-health.en: Regular walking benefits both physical health and general well-being.
physical-health.zh: 经常散步对身体健康和整体幸福都有好处。

health-insurance.en: Employers should provide health insurance for all full-time workers.
health-insurance.zh: 雇主应该为所有全职员工提供健康保险。

preventive.en: Preventive medicine is cheaper than treating diseases at a later stage.
preventive.zh: 预防性医疗比在后期治疗疾病更便宜。

public-health.en: Improving public health should be a priority for every government.
public-health.zh: 改善公共卫生应该是每个政府的优先事项。

excluded.en: Older people may feel excluded from a society that relies on the internet.
excluded.zh: 在依赖互联网的社会中,老年人可能感到被排斥。

outmoded.en: Some people believe that the idea of arranged marriage is outmoded.
outmoded.zh: 有些人认为包办婚姻的观念已经过时了。

depressed.en: People who feel lonely are more likely to become depressed.
depressed.zh: 感到孤独的人更容易变得抑郁。

stressful.en: Living in a large city can be noisy and stressful.
stressful.zh: 住在大城市可能既吵闹又有压力。

retirement-home.en: Moving to a retirement home can be a difficult decision for older people.
retirement-home.zh: 搬进养老院对老年人来说可能是个艰难的决定。

suicide.en: Mental health services can help to reduce the risk of suicide among teenagers.
suicide.zh: 心理健康服务有助于降低青少年的自杀风险。

smoker.en: A smoker is far more likely to develop lung cancer than other people.
smoker.zh: 吸烟者患肺癌的可能性远高于其他人。
